name: discord-presence
description: Shows Claude Code as one Discord activity for the whole app: the active chat title, time in that chat, tokens used today and what Claude is doing. Plugin only, needs Python 3.

clientId.title: Discord Application ID (override)
clientId.description: Leave empty to use the built-in app. Set it to show your own app name on Discord.

imageBase.title: Image base URL (override)
imageBase.description: An https folder URL that holds large.png, thinking.png, tools.png, waiting.png and idle.png. Leave empty for the built-in images.
